keymap._comment: RUN FIRST: proves '\\' and '!' reach DOS before a game depends on them. Look at the screenshot: a directory listing of \\GAMES is a pass.

_comment: Per game item: boot_wait (s from load_core to the DOS prompt; default --boot-wait), steps (type|wait|click|key), run (s of screenshots after the steps), shot_every (s), max_static_s (the longest the screen may sit unchanged), min_changes (screenshot pairs that must differ), known_frame {ref, max_diff, by_s, not_before_s}. A step argument that begins with '?' means the command has not been supplied yet: the item is SKIPPED, never passed. 'pngo' (a batch file on the example disk) and the 50 s wait and the title click are an example Policenauts recipe. known_frame refs are PNGs in --refs (your directory; game frames are not committed): make them with --record-refs from a build you have seen work. config_default: rewrite a 'REM DEFAULTn' boot-menu default in CONFIG.SYS of that item's image COPY (on the example disk: 0 = noemm, 1 = himem, 2 = emm386, 3 = full with NECCD; DOOM refuses EMM386 and needs 0).
